summary: Story search and single-story detail are live calls to Digg's public search endpoint, covering every topic Digg currently lists, with no local search copy; the ranked feed is read live per topic; sync only snapshots ranked lists for rank history; and a view Digg stops serving is removed from the CLI, MCP tools and docs instead of returning empty data with a success exit.
reason: Digg's surface keeps moving: it dropped its old search and status endpoints in October 2026, then published a search endpoint with scores and dates while its pages stopped carrying events, score evidence, sentiment, cross-references, replacements and the emerging and movers rankings. A local copy of the feed went stale, covered one topic by default and hid outages as empty results, which zeroed out downstream research tools. A regen must re-discover the endpoints, tool names, topic list and result fields Digg serves at that time rather than trust the ones recorded here. Search still writes each result's short id, UUID and topic to the local store so story commands can resolve a short id, and research pipelines run several searches at once against one store under a hard timeout: that write stays best-effort, takes SQLite's write lock up front so concurrent writers queue instead of failing with SQLITE_BUSY, and is time-bounded so it can never change search results or the exit code.
validated_outcome: TestSearchConcurrentProcessesShareOneStore runs separate search processes against one store; TestSearchUnwritableStoreStillReturnsResults shows a failed id write leaves results and exit code alone; TestSearchServerErrorIsNotAnEmptyResult and TestPostsDiggErrorIsNotAnEmptyResult show a failed call exits non-zero; TestCommandsDiggNoLongerFeedsAreRemoved and TestRegisterToolsOmitsRemovedCommands pin the removals; doctor reports the search endpoint as its own check.
